Bright and spacious 2-bedroom, 2-full-bathroom garden-level suite located in the highly sought-after Dunbar neighbourhood. Situated on a quiet residential street, this fully furnished home offers comfortable and convenient living with easy access to UBC, Kerrisdale, and Point Grey.

The home is situated on the garden level of a house and benefits from the property's sloped lot, providing a more open and accessible feel than a traditional basement suite.
